verdict.rationale: The evidence covers Agent Observability evaluations: managed evaluators, LLM-as-a-judge, external evaluation submission via `LLMObs.submit_evaluation()`, and dataset versioning. Nothing documents human annotation queues or routing outputs to human reviewers for labeling. The external-evaluation API is at most a building block a developer could use to construct a review workflow, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an ML engineer, I can route outputs to human annotation queues for review and labeling
